predictions_frozen_before_run.drops: If omission drops materially, c3 likely shares a BROADER mechanism: a size-like term is treated as already specifying quantity/portion while prose still asks, because the semantic state remains unresolved.
predictions_frozen_before_run.holds: If omission stays near its measured base rate, c3 is a DIFFERENT D1 SUBTYPE and must split from the Five Guys repair.
predictions_frozen_before_run.control: Same-run healthy control must stay clean, or the round is VOID.
predictions_frozen_before_run.no_conclusion: No brand, prompt or DEFAULTABILITY conclusion either way.
predictions_frozen_before_run.\u26d4_do_not_merge: Round 1 established SECONDARY-COMPONENT vague size causally. A Panda separation would only support a BROADER size-like lexical specification mechanism. These must NOT be merged into one defect unless both manipulations point the same direction.
predictions_frozen_before_run.threshold: Rule-of-three cut as before: >=3 of 8 asks zero-record = still omitting; <=2 = materially reduced; <4 asks = INSUFFICIENT. VOID if the control shows any zero-record ask.
predictions_frozen_before_run.baseline_caveat: This BASELINE is a NEW utterance, not c3 verbatim - it lists 3 entrees + 1 side, which is what a Bigger Plate actually is. c3's measured 3/5 is CONTEXT ONLY. The in-run baseline is the comparison; if it fails to reproduce omission, the round is UNDER-POWERED, not explained away.
